description: An example FastAPI application demonstrating WebSocket communication with an HTML frontend, including routes for serving HTML, WebSocket endpoint with dependency injection for cookie/token handling, and client-side JavaScript for WebSocket interaction.

classes.name: FastAPI
classes.description: Main application class for FastAPI, used to instantiate the web application object.

classes.name: WebSocket
classes.description: Represents a WebSocket connection object for real-time bidirectional communication.

classes.name: HTMLResponse
classes.description: Response class for returning HTML content.

methods.name: get()
methods.description: Handles GET requests at root path '/', returns the chat HTML page.

methods.name: get_cookie_or_token( websocket: WebSocket, session: Annotated[str | None, Cookie()] = None, token: Annotated[str | None, Query()] = None, )
methods.description: Dependency function to retrieve session cookie or token from query, raises WebSocketException if both are missing.

methods.name: websocket_endpoint( *, websocket: WebSocket, item_id: str, q: int | None = None, cookie_or_token: Annotated[str, Depends(get_cookie_or_token)], )
methods.description: WebSocket route handler for '/items/{item_id}/ws', manages WebSocket communication, including accepting connection, processing messages, and sending responses.
